goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: Employees pursuing a formal degree or diploma relevant to their role may apply for study assistance covering up to 50% of tuition fees, capped at R30,000 per academic year. It requires a 12-month retention agreement, with pro-rated repayment if the employee resigns within 12 months.
keywords: Employees pursuing a formal degree or diploma

story: An employee asks what tuition support is available for their own formal studies.
starting_sentence: What study assistance is available for employees doing a formal degree or diploma?
